name: @vidhira/rag
description: Shared RAG layer (Qdrant client, OpenRouter embeddings, chunking, ingest/retrieve/clauses/reprocess) used at request time by apps/api and as batch jobs by apps/worker, per docs/MASTER-PROMPT.md Phase 4. The Supabase client and the per-provider call counter are injected by each app at boot (setSupabaseClient/setCallHook) rather than imported directly, so this package has no dependency on either app's own config/observability code.
